summary: I tested TB-EM-005 Center Operations end to end on the public preview, in the browser and against the API. Every requested journey passes. (1) Harbor admin home: the trial banner shows 30 days and 2/3 seats, the 4 metrics show, and the today card shows. (2) Children: an empty submit lists the missing fields; registering a child redirects to ?registered=1 with a success notice; a second registration shows the 1-child trial error. (3) Guardians: adding a guardian shows the Invited status, and resend works. (4) Assigning Leila Hassan as lead works and appears on the care team card. (5) Booking works from the child page and from /app/schedule. Booking an unassigned therapist (Jordan) returns 'Assign this therapist…', and double-booking returns 'The therapist already has an appointment at this time.' (6) Schedule: prev/next/today and the therapist filter work; Move reschedules; Cancel needs a reason. (7) Therapist Leila sees only her assigned child and own appointments, with no register, book, move or cancel buttons, and 'My day' on home. (8) Parent: the outbox invite activated a new account, which landed on /app with family-child, family-team and family-upcoming. Nav is Home and Security only, /app/children is denied, and the DOM has no email or DOB. After the guardian was removed, the parent saw family-empty. (9) Archiving cancelled both future appointments and ended the assignment; the Archived filter lists the child, and restore works. (10) Platform trial extension rejects 200 days ('Extend by 1 to 90 days'); 1 day changed 30 to 31 days left. (11) Team: the first therapist invite brought seats to 3/3; a second showed staff-invite-error with the 3-seat message. The invite was revoked and seats went back to 2/3. (12) API pytest: 10/10 pass. (13) At 390px, the children list, child page, schedule and family home have no horizontal page overflow. Main defects: the warm family theme is not applied in the real app, appointment times use the browser's time zone instead of the center's, and the new event types show as raw keys in History.

minor.issue: Neither calls trialService.assertWritable, so both still change data after the trial expires (end assignment also cancels appointments). This breaks the 'expiry makes the center read-only' rule. It may be intentional for safeguarding guardian removal, but it is not documented.

If the email matches an existing ACTIVE guardian membership at the center, the link is created and connected immediately, with no invitation or acceptance. A staff typo with another parent's email gives that parent the child's name, care team and schedule straight away. Consider requiring acceptance (an invitation) even for connected guardians.
The supervisor reads the full children list and child details (200). test_credentials.md describes the supervisor as 'center summary + own profile'. Confirm the intended scope.

ui_bugs.component: Family home (Dashboards.tsx FamilyHome, Card tone='family', EmptyState tone='family')
ui_bugs.issue: The warm family theme never applies in the real app. The fam-* classes use var(--fam-*), which is only defined under .theme-family-light/.theme-family-auto. Those classes are only set by the design-preview AppShell, not the real /app workspace shell. Measured on family-child: background is rgba(0,0,0,0) (transparent), the border is navy rgb(20,33,61), and --fam-surface is empty. Result: the card has a dark navy outline on the clinical gray canvas, not the warm theme.

Times are entered and shown in the browser's time zone, not the center's (America/New_York). In a UTC browser, booking 15:00 stored 15:00Z, which is 11:00 in New York, and the list showed 3:00 PM. The today card and My day say 'America/New York', so labels and times disagree. Week grouping also uses the browser's time zone, while the dashboard's dayStart uses the center's time zone.

Labels are missing for the new event types: child.registered/updated/archived/restored, guardian.added/removed, assignment.started/ended, appointment.scheduled/rescheduled/cancelled/completed/no_show and trial.extended. They show as raw keys on the child history and platform center history.

design_issues.screen: Child archive dialog / appointment cancel dialog
issues: Confirming with no reason (or one under 3 characters) silently does nothing; no message tells the user that a reason is needed.

Service is not preselected when the child has only one service, and the therapist list includes therapists who are not assigned, so the user can only find out from the booking error. Consider listing assigned therapists for the selected service first.
Date and Start use native date/time inputs (the browser's default pickers) rather than the design-system picker; the child DOB field does too.
The seat hint 'Pending invitations count' is unclear; something like 'Includes pending invitations' would read better.
The schedule shows the legal name (TEST_Avery TEST_Quinn) while the child page and family home use the preferred name (Avi); pick one rule.
The subtitle starts with a stray dot when the city is empty: '· America/New York'.
The search input plus button does not fill the row width; there is leftover space on the right.

action_items: Apply the family theme in the real app: add the theme-family-auto (or theme-family-light) class to the workspace shell or the family home wrapper when the active role is GUARDIAN, so the --fam-* variables resolve.

Show and enter appointment times in the center's time zone (America/New_York) in BookDialog, the schedule week grouping, the today card and the child appointments, or label times clearly with the browser's time zone.
Add EVENT_LABELS for the TB-EM-005 events (child.*, guardian.*, assignment.*, appointment.*, trial.extended).
Decide whether removeGuardian and endAssignment should be blocked after the trial expires, then add assertWritable or document the exception.
Show a validation message when the archive or cancel reason is under 3 characters.
critical_code_review_comments: children.service removeGuardian and endAssignment do not lock the center or check expiry, unlike every other write.
addGuardian auto-connects an existing guardian account by email match, with no consent step (privacy risk if the email is mistyped).
BookDialog builds the date with new Date(`${date}T${time}`), which uses the browser's local time; the center time zone is ignored.
The schedule list's 42-day limit and the 500-row take are fine; dashboard today includes cancelled appointments in the list (metric-today filters to SCHEDULED), which is OK.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows functional; 3 UI defects (family theme, time zone, history labels)

rca of the issue: Family theme: tailwind maps fam-* colors to var(--fam-*). Those variables are only defined by the .theme-family-* selectors (familyThemeCss in styles/tokens.ts). The real app shell never adds those classes (only design-preview AppShell.tsx line 92 does), so bg-fam-surface is transparent and border-fam-border falls back to currentColor (navy).
